integrity: Exact finite clique and group presentation computations, constructive elementary collapses, and a signed Lefschetz calculation; verifier included. Independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The integral H2 rank 64 is already implied by published Latin-square-graph homology theory; a previous complete translation-character formula also covers this translation restriction. Novelty concerns only the homotopy and full 600-element semiaffine-character statements. The proof concerns only Paley(25). Equivalent unindexed results remain a risk.
title: A sixty-four-sphere wedge and a 600-symmetry character for the Paley-25 flag complex
